subject: Flavonoid from vine tea selectively clears senescent microglia, repairs DNA in aging cells
script: From Agewell Brief: Flavonoid from vine tea selectively clears senescent microglia, repairs DNA in aging cells. Dihydromyricetin, a natural flavonoid, acts as a senomorphic in fibroblasts by boosting PRDX2 nuclear translocation for DNA repair, and as a senolytic in microglia by disrupting mitochondrial function—offering a dual mechanism to combat age-related decline. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
